newsitem.title: HAITI: 11 Haitians die at sea when boat sinks - report.
newsitem.headline: 11 Haitians die at sea when boat sinks - report.

text.p: At least 11 people drowned when a boat carrying 35 Haitians bound for the Bahamas sank, Radio Haiti Inter reported on Tuesday.

The vessel went down on Saturday after leaving the town of Moustique in the northwestern region of Haiti, hard hit by famine due to a severe drought, the radio report said. Each passenger paid $500 for a space on the vessel.
Four people died recently of hunger in the northwestern region, the report said.
The Haitian government was holding meetings with international organisations in the area to find solutions to the famine, officials said.
